{"task": {"id": "I_kwDONElfw88AAAABbXqFgw", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlV6PzhE8FCw", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlV6P", "number": 106, "title": "Normalize PMD/PMX texture resource paths before cache lookup and loading", "body": "## Problem

Follow-up from [mmd-gltf #73](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/issues/73) and [its Draft PR #74](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/pull/74).

The downstream implementation found that the pinned Uka PMX contains the original relative texture filename `tex\hair_s01.png`. At the investigated upstream baseline, `MaterialBuilder._loadTexture` in `src/loaders/MMDLoader.ts` constructed non-default-toon URLs with `this.resourcePath + filePath` before cache lookup, handler selection and loading. Relative Windows/mixed separators therefore do not share one canonical resource URL across those operations.

This is a confirmed source-level path-handling problem; it does not by itself prove the cause of the reported Android image load/decode failure. Keep those conclusions separate.

## Expected outcome

Fix PMD/PMX relative texture resource resolution in the reusable library, before base joining, cache lookup, handler/loader selection and diagnostics.

- Normalize Windows, POSIX and mixed relative separators, redundant separators and safe dot segments.
- Handle spaces, Unicode and percent-encoded/literal-percent filenames consistently, without double encoding or reinterpreting escaped literal bytes (including `%25FF.png` and `100%25ab.png`).
- Reject unsafe relative traversal and encoded separator/control/traversal cases before fetching, while preserving valid absolute/data/blob URLs and the existing built-in toon path.
- Apply the same semantics to base, sphere/subtexture and custom toon textures, including TGA selection, cache identity and cached-error callbacks.
- Preserve original parsed filenames/asset bytes independently from normalized fetch URLs. Distinguish invalid paths from HTTP or image-decode failures. Preserve existing loader behavior outside this correction.

## Existing implementation evidence

A candidate source patch and independent tests are already available in the downstream PR:

- [Candidate upstream patch](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/3bf1b9d30036e5d0519fa2b43e3ffbfa797052af/patches/three-mmd-loader-resource-path.patch)
- [Resolver and integration rationale](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/3bf1b9d30036e5d0519fa2b43e3ffbfa797052af/docs/pmx-resource-paths.md)
- [Recorded validation](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/3bf1b9d30036e5d0519fa2b43e3ffbfa797052af/docs/pmx-resource-path-validation.json)

The patch targets upstream commit `5ae203246ccffd86a3e8fb7be0e34b9559c33a46` and changes `MMDLoader.ts`, adds `MMDResourcePath.ts` and `tests/resource-path.test.ts`. The downstream implementation reported clean patch application and eight relevant upstream tests passing. These are prior results, not validation of the current upstream main: inspect the current source, review/adapt the patch and rerun the repository's required checks.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Loader resource resolution occurs before cache lookup, loader/handler selection, requests and error reporting, across the affected texture families.
- [ ] Automated tests cover Windows/POSIX/mixed paths, Unicode/spaces, valid encoded literal-percent filenames, equivalent-path cache reuse, TGA selection, custom/default toon, sphere/subtexture, original-name retention and error callbacks.
- [ ] Unsafe relative paths are rejected before fetching; valid absolute/data URLs and existing special paths retain their intended behavior.
- [ ] Integration/browser tests inspect actual canonical request URLs and preserve retry/error behavior; a cosmetic error-message replacement is insufficient.
- [ ] Run the repository's documented applicable typecheck, unit, browser, build and package/consumer checks and report exact outcomes and limitations.
- [ ] Keep this focused on the reusable loader correction; no changes to unrelated rendering, physics, IK or original third-party model/image files.

## Ownership and downstream integration

The maintainer requested a `task` Issue handoff, rather than having the mmd-gltf Task create an upstream branch or PR. This library's own Task workflow owns implementation and review. The downstream Task must link this Issue and keep its narrow, tested compatibility shim explicit while a corrected library release is unavailable; it must not repeatedly attempt cross-repository PR publication.

After a corrected release is available, mmd-gltf can update its dependency/lockfile and remove the temporary shim under its own integration work. Physical Android verification remains separately tracked in mmd-gltf #73; desktop tests must not be described as physical Android verification.

## Required post-merge verification

Follow this repository's normal release/deployment verification policy. No physical Android device or downstream release is required to merge an independently verified library correction.
